description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Ballkone tek Pallatet Cabej.
Apartamenti disponon nje siperfaqe totale prej 95 m2 nga te cilat 87.1 m2 jane pjese e siperfaqes se brendshme.
Organizohet ne;
- Sallon ndenje bashke me kendin e gatimit dhe te ngrenies
- 2 dhoma gjumi
- 1 tualet,
- 2 ballkone,
- nje korridor i cili ben te mundur shperndarjen e ambienteve te apartamentit si dhe 2 depo.
- Orientimi Jug-Perendim ben te mundur qe apartamenti te kete drite natyrale pergjate pjeses me te madhe te dites.
- Siperfaqe neto 87m/2
- Siperfaqe bruto 95m/2
- kati i 8te i nje pallati me ashensor.
- Disponon dokumentacion te rregullut hipotekore -
description_en: 2+1+2 Balcony Apartment for sale at Cabej Buildings. The apartment has a total surface of 95 m2, of which 87.1 m2 are part of the interior surface. It is organized in; - Living room with kitchen and dining area - 2 bedrooms - 1 toilet, - 2 balconies, - a corridor which makes it possible to distribute the premises of the apartment as well as 2 storage rooms. - South-West orientation makes it possible for the apartment to have natural light throughout most of the day. - Net area 87m/2 - Gross area 95m/2 - 8th floor of a building with elevator. - Has documentation of the mortgage rule -
